title: The headless research-queue run calls the docs servers directly and bypasses the 7-day live-docs cache
goal: ql_research.py gives its research run the kb server's cached docs_search and docs_fetch instead of the direct docs-server tools, so a repeated search in the queue within 7 days makes no call to the docs server

run: import sys; sys.exit(0 if 'mcp__kb__docs_search' in open('_tools/ql_research.py',encoding='utf-8').read() else 1)
